newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Nippon Credit Bank urged to merge.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Nippon Credit Bank urged to merge.

text.p: Troubled Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) should merge with the governmental Japan Development Bank, a senior policy planner with the ruling Liberal Democratic Party was quoted as saying on Sunday.
The Tokyo Shimbun newspaper quoted LDP Policy Affairs Research Council Chairman Taku Yamasaki as saying that the newly merged bank should be placed under a financial holding company.
NCB, facing massive bad loans at its three nonbank affiliates, is to announce a restructuring plan soon.

"In my view, the Japan Development Bank should be privatised and merged with (NCB) via a holding company... The restructuring plan, if mapped out, would put NCB's management in order," the paper quoted Yamasaki as saying.
NCB's restructuring plan, due in April, is expected to include halting all of its overseas operations and boosting its capital.
NCB said a company spokesperson was unavailable for comment on the remarks.
